name: Morse code
summary: Morse Code is a signal-based EA that generates buy and sell entries using dot-and-dash pattern logic derived from price action or indicator crossovers, analogous to Morse code signals. It systematically translates these pattern signals into market entries and exits, operating without manual intervention. The EA appears to focus on momentum-driven entries based on short-term pattern recognition.
summary_zh: Morse Code EA是一种基于信号模式的交易系统，利用类似摩尔斯电码的点划模式逻辑（源自价格行为或指标交叉）生成买卖信号。它系统地将这些模式信号转化为市场入场和出场操作，无需人工干预。该EA主要关注基于短期模式识别的动量入场。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA采用类似摩尔斯电码的点（短信号）和划（长信号）模式来识别市场动量变化，将价格行为或指标变化编码为可交易的信号序列。入场条件：当检测到特定的点划组合模式时触发买入或卖出信号，可能基于短期和长期移动平均线的交叉或价格突破来定义'点'和'划'。出场条件：可能采用固定止盈止损或反向信号出现时平仓，具体取决于参数设置。仓位管理：根据账户余额和风险参数计算手数，可能支持固定手数或动态手数调整。资金管理：EA可能包含最大持仓限制和最大回撤控制，但具体实现取决于参数配置。
strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This EA employs a Morse code-like dot (short signal) and dash (long signal) pattern system to identify momentum shifts in the market, encoding price action or indicator changes into tradeable signal sequences. Entry conditions: Buy or sell signals are triggered when specific dot-dash combination patterns are detected, likely defined by short-term and long-term moving average crossovers or price breakouts. Exit conditions: May use fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or close positions when a reversal signal pattern appears, depending on parameter settings. Position sizing: Lot sizes are calculated based on account balance and risk parameters, potentially supporting both fixed and dynamic lot sizing. Money management: The EA may include maximum position limits and drawdown controls, though the specific implementation depends on the parameter configuration.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to close (0 for all positions)

pros: 创新的点划模式识别方法，提供独特的市场信号解读视角
系统化交易减少情绪干扰，严格执行信号规则
模式识别可以捕捉短期动量变化，响应速度快
pros_en: Innovative dot-dash pattern recognition approach provides a unique perspective on market signal interpretation
Systematic trading reduces emotional interference and strictly executes signal rules
Pattern recognition can capture short-term momentum shifts with fast response times
cons: 点划模式定义可能过于简化，无法充分反映复杂市场动态
缺乏对市场波动性和点差的过滤，可能在不利条件下产生虚假信号
模式识别逻辑在震荡市中可能频繁触发错误信号导致连续亏损
cons_en: The dot-dash pattern definition may be oversimplified and unable to fully reflect complex market dynamics
Lack of volatility and spread filtering may generate false signals under unfavorable conditions
Pattern recognition logic may frequently trigger wrong signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），在震荡市中减少交易频率
加入点差过滤和滑点保护机制，提高实盘执行的可靠性
improvements_en: Add a market state filter (such as ADX or volatility indicator) to reduce trading frequency in ranging markets
Incorporate spread filtering and slippage protection mechanisms to improve real-world execution reliability

risk_points: 模式识别可能在震荡市中产生大量虚假信号
缺乏明确的市场状态判断机制，趋势和震荡市中采用相同策略
risk_points_en: Pattern recognition may generate numerous false signals in ranging markets
Lack of explicit market state detection means the same strategy is applied in both trending and ranging conditions

It systematically translates these pattern signals into market entries and exits, operating without manual intervention. The EA appears to focus on momentum-driven entries based on short-term pattern recognition.
